raw.title: Field Marketing Manager
raw.description:
About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why This Role

FLUX gets attention the moment people see it. Your job is to turn that attention into pipeline.

You'll own two motions where FLUX meets enterprises and partners in person: the events where customers experience the models firsthand, and the co-marketing engine with cloud and distribution partners who bring FLUX to the market. You’ll work directly with GTM, Partnerships, and our creative technologists. Our release cadence means there’s always a new reason to show up. Your job is to make sure we show up well and that every appearance has a number attached to it in order to effectively measure impact.

What you’ll work on

Events

  • Shape BFL's event calendar end-to-end: tier the opportunities, decide where we show up, and run the full events lifecycle: booths, demos, speaker slots, exec briefings, side events, follow up and more

  • Design event experiences that demonstrate the models, not just talk about them; working with Creative Technologists and FDEs on interactive demos and installations

  • Build the pre/post event machine: target lists for Sales, meeting orchestration on-site, pipeline attribution afterward. Every event has a number attached to measure impact (MQL’s)

  • Run BFL-hosted formats: customer dinners, launch events, and executive roundtables in key markets, plus side events at major moments (GTC, research oriented, etc.)

Co-marketing with partners

  • Own the co-marketing motion with our distribution and cloud partners; joint announcements, launch-day amplification, case studies, shared event presence

  • Coordinate partner marketing calendars around BFL launches so every major release lands with multiplied reach

  • Build repeatable co-marketing playbooks per partner tier, and negotiate marketing commitments into partnership conversations alongside the Partnerships team

GTM Enablement

  • Pitch decks

  • Solution marketing

Connecting the motions

  • Co-own the activation calendar with our social marketing team so events, partner moments, and social land together

  • Feed what you learn on the floor (what lands, the questions enterprises actually ask back into GTM and product marketing)

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6 years in field/event marketing, partner marketing, or integrated campaigns at a B2B tech company

  • You've run events end-to-end (from a 10-person exec dinner to a major conference presence) and can show the pipeline they produced

  • You've done co-marketing with large partners

  • You understand enterprise marketing: how buying committees work, what an exec briefing needs to accomplish, why attribution matters

  • 80%+ execution. You can build the run-of-show, brief the booth staff, etc.

  • Strong visual taste: our outputs are judged visually, and so are our activations

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, tight timelines, and launch weeks where everything happens at once

While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Experience marketing generative AI, creative tooling, or developer-facing infrastructure

  • Existing relationships in the creative AI community

  • Experience working with cloud or platform partners on joint GTM

  • You've built an event or campaign that people in the industry still reference

  • Time spent working in the US, or in a role with significant US market ownership

How We Work Together

We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your location, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you.

Base Annual Salary:

US $160,000- $200,000 + equity
EU €105,000- €130,000 + equity

About Bliro

Bei Bliro revolutionieren wir den Arbeitsalltag von Außendienstteams mithilfe von KI. 2.5 Millionen Außendienstler allein in Deutschland verlieren täglich Stunden an manuelle Nachbereitung. Bliro löst genau das - mit Transkription und den KI-Voice-Agents Vicky und Tim, die Kundengespräche vor-und nachbereiten, Besuchsberichte dokumentieren und das CRM in Echtzeit aktualisieren. Per Sprache wird so die gesamte Schreibtischarbeit automatisiert und der Außendienst gesteuert.

Schon heute vertrauen über 2.000 Unternehmen auf Bliro - darunter schnell wachsende Start-ups, etablierte Corporates und mittelständische Unternehmen (z.B. igus, Lanxess und Telefonica Deutschland). Unterstützt von Top-Investoren, suchen wir nun dich als Vollzeitmitglied im Bereich Account Executive (AE), um unser Wachstum weiter voranzutreiben.

Unser Sales Team bringt Erfahrung aus den schnellstwachsenden Software Unternehmen der Welt (Ex-Deel, Ex-Autodesk, Ex-Celonis) und eigenen Unternehmensgründungen mit!

👇 Sieh selbst, was du an Vertriebsteams verkaufen wirst:

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

Als Account Executive bei Bliro verantwortest du den gesamten Sales-Cycle - von der Demo bis zum Abschluss. Du arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unserem SDR-Team, das deinen Kalender mit qualifizierten Demos füllt, damit du dich auf das konzentrieren kannst, was du am besten kannst: Deals zu closen.

  • Du leitest Discovery Calls und maßgeschneiderte Produkt-Demos mit Mid-Market- und Enterprise-Prospects.

  • Du steuerst komplexe Sales-Cycles und verhandelst Verträge mit ACVs von 50k€+.

  1. Mit dem gesamten Go-to-Market-Team zusammenarbeiten

  • Du arbeitest eng mit den SDRs zusammen, die deine Termine buchen - für einen reibungslosen Handoff und enge Zusammenarbeit.

  • Arbeite eng mit dem Customer Success Team für reibungslose Handoffs sowie mit Growth zur Schärfung unserer GTM-Strategie.

  • Du teilst Feedback aus dem Feld, um unsere Roadmap mitzugestalten.

  1. Quota übertreffen und Wachstum vorantreiben

  • Du clost konsequent neues Business, um die ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen - und zu übertreffen.

  • Du baust deine Pipeline in Schlüsselbranchen und -regionen aus.

  • Du positionierst Bliro als vertrauenswürdigen Partner für Kunden, die ihre Vertriebsprozesse mit KI transformieren wollen.

Wir suchen motivierte AEs, die für High-Touch-B2B-SaaS-Sales brennen und mit einem kategoriedefinierenden AI-Startup wachsen wollen.

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • Nachweisliche Erfolge im Abschluss von Mid-Market- und Enterprise-SaaS-Deals (ACVs von 50k€ und mehr).

  • Exzellente Kommunikations- und Beziehungsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

Bei uns weißt du von Tag 1, wohin die Reise geht. Als AE übernimmst du von Anfang an echte Deals, echte Kunden und echte Verantwortung. title: Working Student IT Strategy & Governance (all genders)
description: Über tonies: tonies ist die weltweit führende interaktive Audio-Plattform für Kinder mit mehr als 10 Millionen verkauften Tonieboxen und 125 Millionen verkauften Tonies. Das intuitive und preisgekrönte Audiosystem hat mit seinem kindersicheren, kabellosen und bildschirmfreien Ansatz die Art und Weise verändert, wie kleine Kinder selbstständig spielen und lernen. Tonieboxen wurden bereits in über 100 Ländern aktiviert und das Inhaltsportfolio umfasst rund 1.400 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen. Seit der Gründung hat tonies bedeutende Meilensteine erreicht – darunter den Börsengang an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im November 2021 sowie ein weltweit präsentes Team von über 550 engagierten Experten, die aus verschiedenen Ländern agieren. Teil unseres tonies-Teams zu werden bedeutet, Teil einer inspirierenden Mission zu sein: innovative und bedeutungsvolle Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie. Du als Teil von tonies: Wir suchen einen motivierten Werkstudenten zur Verstärkung unseres IT Strategy & Governance Teams, der unsere Experten innerhalb der CIO- & CPO-Einheiten dabei unterstützt, das nachhaltige Wachstum von tonies voranzutreiben. Du wirst eng mit dem Enterprise Architect, dem IT Governance Analysten und dem Manager Trust & Security zusammenarbeiten, um die IT-Strategie, Standards und Leitplanken zu definieren. So ermöglichst du es den tonies-Mitarbeitenden, unserer wachsenden globalen Kundenbasis effektiv sichere und stabile Produkte mit einem skalierbaren Fundament zu bieten. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der organisiert, zuverlässig und lernbegierig ist sowie Interesse daran hat, eine Karriere im IT-Bereich in einem internationalen Umfeld aufzubauen. Deine Aufgaben umfassen: IT-Strategie & Architektur Bewerten der tonies-Systemlandschaft im Hinblick auf den strategischen Fit. Unterstützen strategischer IT-Projekte (z. B. Stammdatenmanagement, Lizenzgebühren/Royalties, E-Commerce). Pflegen der Enterprise-Architektur-Dokumentation in LeanIX. IT-Governance & Sicherheit Vorqualifizieren neuer Software-Anfragen und Beraten fachübergreifender Stakeholder (IT, Data/AI, Einkauf, Legal). Pflegen des tonies-Applikationsportfolios (System Ownership, CIA-Scoring, Kosten, Nutzung etc.). Optimieren von Verlängerungsprozessen durch Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Aktualisierung des Softwarelizenz-Verlängerungsplans. Aufsetzen und iteratives Weiterentwickeln von IT-Security-Onlinetrainingsmodulen für Mitarbeitende. Unterstützen von ISO 27001-, ITIL- und allgemeinen Compliance-Initiativen. Was wir uns von dir wünschen: Studienstatus: Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Bachelor- oder Masterstudiengang (z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Informationsmanagement oder einem verwandten Bereich). Bereichsinteresse: Starkes Interesse an IT-Architektur, Enterprise Security und Governance-Standards. Denkweise: Bewusster Umgang mit modernen Tools – nach dem Motto „Think First, AI Second“. Tech Stack: Vertrautheit mit den gängigen Produktivitäts-Suites (Google Workspace oder Microsoft 365). Arbeitsweise: Strukturiert, zuverlässig und detailorientiert mit der Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für übertragene Aufgaben zu übernehmen. Soft Skills: Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, sowohl eigenständig als auch im Team zu arbeiten. Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich (Englisch ist ein Plus). Warum tonies? Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies ® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen. Jedes Gesicht ist bei uns willkommen und wird in allen Entwicklungsphasen mit und von uns unterstützt. Wir freuen uns auf deine digitale Bewerbung! raw.title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/x)
raw.description:
Data Scientist (m/f/x) 

Location: EU

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Data Scientists who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. Ifyou're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

Develop and Deploy Production-Grade AI Systems 

  • Build, deploy, and maintain scalable APIs that serve AI/ML models in production environments 

  • Own end-to-end delivery of AI solutions, from prototyping to fully productionized systems 

Design Advanced AI Architectures 

  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using vector databases 

  • Build and orchestrate AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Evaluate and select appropriate large language models (LLMs) and foundation models based on specific use cases 

Optimize Performance and Scalability 

  • Continuously optimize model inference for latency, cost efficiency, and throughput at scale 

  • Identify bottlenecks and implement improvements to ensure high-performing systems 

Ensure Reliability and Observability 

  • Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for deployed models and services 

  • Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance through best practices in production ML systems 

Establish Engineering Best Practices 

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless testing, deployment, and iteration of AI systems 

  • Contribute to evolving engineering standards as the company transitions from rapid experimentation to more structured, scalable operations 

Collaborate Cross-Functionally 

  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into core products 

  • Translate business problems into technical solutions and clearly communicate trade-offs 

Drive Structure in a Fast-Paced Environment 

  • Help bring stability and structure to AI development processes during a high-growth, scale-up phase 

  • Balance speed of execution with the need for maintainable, well-documented, and scalable systems 

  • Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them through to practical, production-ready outcomes 


Core Experience 

  • 5+ years of experience in Python, with ~10 years of overall software engineering or data experience (candidates transitioning from backend engineering are welcome) 

  • Proven experience building and deploying production-grade APIs (preferably with FastAPI; REST/GraphQL experience is a plus) 

  • Hands-on experience working with large language models (LLMs) and LLMOps, including prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation (e.g., GPT, Claude) 

  • Strong experience fine-tuning open-source models (e.g., Hugging Face ecosystem) 

  • Practical experience designing and working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) 

  • Experience building AI agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or similar 

  • Solid understanding of model deployment and serving (e.g., vLLM, TGI, or managed endpoints) 

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions) 

  • Strong experience working with and processing large-scale text datasets 

Preferred Experience 

  • Experience with MLOps platforms such as MLflow or Weights & Biases 

  • Familiarity with cloud AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI) 

  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects 

  • Experience in the sustainability or climate/product domain 

  • Background in B2B SaaS environments 

  • Prior experience in a startup or scale-up environment (approximately 100–300 employees) 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

Key Attributes 

  • Builder mindset: Comfortable owning systems end-to-end, from experimentation through to production 

  • Bias for action: Operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment with shifting priorities 

  • Systems thinker: Designs solutions with scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind 

  • Pragmatic decision-making: Balances technical excellence with speed and business impact 

  • Ownership & accountability: Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs 

  • Clear communicator: Able to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

 

 

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.

  • Build and evolve microservice-based and event-driven architectures
  • Develop APIs using GraphQL
  • Work with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive (WebFlux)
  • Design and optimize data models using MySQL and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability of backend systems
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Implement performance testing and end-to-end testing
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and technical best practices
  • Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership when needed
  • Collaborate on AI-enabled features, including prompt engineering and backend integrations

 Your Profile:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in backend development
  • Strong expertise in Java 17 or other recent versions (11+)
  • Extensive experience with Spring Boot and Spring Reactive
  • Solid knowledge of MySQL and experience with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB or MongoDB)
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of microservice architecture and event-driven systems
  • Experience building and consuming GraphQL APIs
  • Proven experience with performance optimization and testing
  • Experience with end-to-end testing strategies
  • Experience with prompt engineering for AI-powered applications
  • Excellent understanding of software design and architectural patterns
  • Ability to design elegant, scalable, and maintainable system architectures
  • Strong communication skills and excellent English proficiency

  • Cloud experience (AWS/GCP/Azure)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience building AI-integrated backend systems

title: Senior Account Executive
description: <h2><strong>About Black Forest Labs</strong></h2> <p>We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.</p> <p>Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.</p> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships&nbsp; especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.</p> <p>This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Work On</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises</li> <li>Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams</li> <li>Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing</li> <li>Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion</li> <li>Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals</li> <li>Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research</li> <li>Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <p>You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.</p> <p>You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.</p> <p><strong>You'll likely have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders</li> <li>Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers</li> <li>Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals</li> <li>Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms</li> <li>Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types</li> <li>Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How We Work Together</strong></h2> <p>We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Nobody is above any task.</li> <li><strong>Bold.</strong> We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.</li> <li><strong>Kind.</strong> People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. In this role, you will help monitor and improve our research models, ensure output quality aligns with benchmarks and industry trends, and contribute to exciting analytical projects such as box office prediction, audience analytics, and large-scale data mining initiatives. What you will be doing Monitor day-to-day performance and output quality of research and machine learning models Validate survey results against internal benchmarks and industry trends Identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and opportunities for model improvement Support data mining and exploratory analysis projects Contribute to predictive analytics initiatives, including box office forecasting Work closely with the Lead Data Scientist on operational and strategic data tasks Help maintain and improve data workflows and pipelines Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable and actionable insights What we need from you Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field in Berlin. From a small startup, we've evolved into a 200+ strong team, based in Berlin, around the world, or working remotely. We've been all about building a profitable business while riding that wave of impressive growth.

Who we need

We are a research-driven team focused on delivering high-quality survey insights powered by machine learning models. To support our Lead Data Scientist, we are looking for a motivated and curious Working Student in Data Science who enjoys solving real-world problems, working with imperfect data, and continuously challenging themselves.

In this role, you will help monitor and improve our research models, ensure output quality aligns with benchmarks and industry trends, and contribute to exciting analytical projects such as box office prediction, audience analytics, and large-scale data mining initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants hands-on experience in applied data science within a fast-paced and collaborative environment.


What you will be doing

  • Monitor day-to-day performance and output quality of research and machine learning models

  • Validate survey results against internal benchmarks and industry trends

  • Identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and opportunities for model improvement

  • Support data mining and exploratory analysis projects

  • Contribute to predictive analytics initiatives, including box office forecasting

  • Work closely with the Lead Data Scientist on operational and strategic data tasks

  • Help maintain and improve data workflows and pipelines

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure reliable and actionable insights


    • What we need from you

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field in Berlin. If you are not a student in Berlin, your application will be rejected immediately.

  • A result-driven, pragmatic mindset and the ability to work with imperfect or messy datasets

  • Hands-on mentality with a delivery- and service-oriented attitude

  • Strong analytical thinking and curiosity to challenge assumptions and improve processes

  • First experience with Snowflake, dbt, and/or Airflow

  • Passion for movies and TV shows

  • Good English communication skills

  • Constant learning, delivering results and creating value are the core characteristics of everyone at JustWatch and we are looking for these values in every person we are hiring.

    • What we offer you

  • Hands-on experience with real-world machine learning and research applications

  • Exposure to modern data stack technologies and scalable data workflows

  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful predictive analytics projects

  • A collaborative team environment with room to learn and grow

  • Flexible working conditions tailored to student schedules

Features end-to-end bauen. DB-Schema, API-Route, Frontend, vom Web-Cockpit bis in die Mobile Apps. Du lieferst das Ganze, nicht nur einen Layer. Die Reise vom Ticket zur Production ist bei uns kurz. Code-Reviews übernehmen. Ein großer Teil unseres Codes entsteht mit Claude Code. Du reviewst, was reingeht, erkennst die Stellen, an denen ein Modell halluziniert oder schludert, und sorgst dafür, dass Tempo nicht auf Kosten der Codebase geht. Es gibt keine eigene Dev-Abteilung, sondern ein kleines Team, das Konzept, Build und Betrieb gemeinsam verantwortet und entsprechend eng zusammenarbeitet. Was die Rolle nicht ist: K ein Product Management, keine Konzeptarbeit, kein Stakeholder-Management, keine Führungsverantwortung. Priorisierung und Produktentscheidungen liegen beim Product-Team. Du bist die Execution- und Qualitätsinstanz, nicht der nächste PM. Unser Tech-Stack: Web & API: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19), TypeScript strict, TanStack React Query, Tailwind + shadcn/ui, PWA via Serwist Mobile Apps: React Native mit Expo (drei Apps: Bauleiter, Aufmaßtechniker, Monteure) Backend & DB: Supabase (Postgres, Storage, Realtime) Auth: NextAuth 5 mit Supabase als User-Store Monitoring: Sentry Automation: n8n (self-hosted) Legacy, wird abgelöst: Airtable Integrationen: HubSpot, Lexware, Slack, Autarc Dein Profil Uns interessieren Skills, nicht Jahreszahlen im Lebenslauf. TypeScript und React/Next.js in Produktion gebaut, nicht nur in Side-Projects React Native (Expo) Erfahrung oder die Fähigkeit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten SQL und Postgres auf einem Niveau, auf dem du selbst Schemas designst, Indices setzt und Migrations mit laufendem Betrieb durchziehst API-Design-Erfahrung über Standard-CRUD hinaus: Authorization-Modelle, Idempotenz, saubere Fehlerbehandlung Du hast ernsthaft mit KI-Tools gearbeitet (Claude Code, Cursor oder vergleichbar). Features, die damit entstanden sind, stehen in Produktion. Und du kannst erklären, was du dabei selbst entschieden hast. Du kannst Code-Reviews führen, die andere besser machen, statt sie zu demotivieren Du kannst zeigen, was du gebaut hast: GitHub, Live-Produkt, irgendwas Greifbares Was uns wichtig ist Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Code, den du committest , auch wenn er KI-generiert ist. "Hat Claude gebaut" ist nie eine Ausrede. Du triffst technische Entscheidungen mit Argumenten, nicht aus Bauchgefühl , und kannst sie im Team vertreten. Pragmatismus über Perfektion: das richtige Ding schnell, mit Tech-Debt, die wir bewusst tragen. Du erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Debt, mit der wir leben können, und Debt, die uns einholt. Du redest mit Handwerkern, Vertrieb und Operations verständlich und auf Augenhöhe. Deutsch B2+ oder die Bereitschaft, zügig dahin zu kommen. Unsere User sind Handwerker, unsere UI und unsere Tickets sind auf Deutsch. The Opportunity This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature. The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance. Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition. Why Strong Sellers Join Singu A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch. Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential. Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship. Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee. Forecasting and Governance A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind. Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed. raw.description:
About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.

 

Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

The Opportunity

This is a pure new business role. You own a defined territory and named-account set, the pipeline you create within it, and the commercial outcome of every deal you run, from first conversation to signature.

The deals are consequential rather than transactional: multi-stakeholder, multi-site, six to nine months, with typical initial values of £25k- £100k and clear multi-country expansion potential. Winning takes a business case, not a demonstration and it requires strong discovery, quantified value, access to senior decision-makers and the ability to align stakeholders across operations, real estate, procurement, IT and finance.

Singu supports complex property and facilities operations across more than 250 million square metres, with established customers spanning commercial real estate, logistics, retail, facility management and the public sector. You will enter deals with credible enterprise references, a proven product and senior executive support, not an unproven proposition.

Why Strong Sellers Join Singu

  • A defined territory and named-account set, not an undifferentiated geographic patch.

  • Enterprise deals with meaningful initial value and clear multi-country expansion potential.

  • Dedicated business development, Pre-Sales, marketing and executive sponsorship.

  • Direct access to the CRO for deal strategy, coaching and fast commercial decisions. Pricing, terms and sponsorship all take place without a committee.

  • Uncapped earnings with meaningful accelerators for over-performance.

  • Credible routes into strategic or global accounts or sales leadership.

What You Will Own

Pipeline and Coverage

  • A new business quota, and a territory plan that shows how you intend to hit it.

  • Pipeline built through business development, marketing, partner and self-generated activity, with personal responsibility for coverage across the territory.

  • Diagnostic conversations grounded in operating cost, compliance and risk.

Deal Execution

  • Opportunities qualified to a MEDDICC standard, with a quantified business case and access to the economic buyer.

  • Every material deal multi-threaded, so it survives a change of sponsor.

  • Commercial negotiation that builds value and protects price rather than defaulting to discount.

  • Rigorous qualification and early decisions on opportunities that lack a credible business case, buying process or route to decision.

Land and Expand

  • First wins scoped so they can grow: sites, countries and use cases sequenced from the start.

  • A clean handover to Customer Success, with the expansion path documented.

Forecasting and Governance

  • A forecast that holds, with stage integrity, next steps and close dates you stand behind.

  • Risk surfaced early, with an honest view of what changed and what is needed.

  • Contribution to the playbook i.e. objections, competitive intelligence and repeatable use cases.

What Excellent Performance Looks Like

Commercial outcomes

  • New-logo ARR against quota

  • Pipeline creation and territory coverage

  • Win rate, against incumbents and against no decision

  • Average deal value and total multi-year value

  • Strategic logos won

Operating standards

  • Forecast accuracy and stage integrity

  • Multi-threading and MEDDICC quality

  • Price protection and discount discipline

  • CRM quality and process discipline

Your First 12 Months

  • First 90 days: complete onboarding, build the territory and account plan, establish pipeline coverage and create the first qualified opportunities.

  • By six months: credible coverage against ramped quota, multi-threaded opportunities progressing through evaluation, and a first customer win closed or materially advanced.

  • By 12 months: delivery against ramped quota, a repeatable pipeline-creation motion in your territory, and accounts landed with clear expansion potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • Typically five or more years in B2B software or complex technology sales, including a sustained period carrying a new business quota. Quality of results matters more than years.

  • Evidence of sustained over-performance in new business sales: quota attainment, team ranking, pipeline personally created and representative deals won. We will ask for specifics.

title: Werkstudent:in Landwirtschaft und betriebliche Datenprüfung (all genders) (Berlin I DE Remote möglich)
description: Please note: This job description is written in German as the role requires fluency in German and active collaboration with German-speaking stakeholders. We want to ensure clarity around expectations and language needs from the start. Startdatum: ab 07.09.2026 - Befristet bis 28.02.2027 Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen. Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften. Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen! Deine Mission Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden Unternehmen setzt sich Klim mit dieser Arbeit dafür ein, den CO2-Ausstoß in der Landwirtschaft nachhaltig zu reduzieren, die Bodengesundheit zu verbessern und Artenvielfalt zu fördern. Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt. Als Teil unseres MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification)-Teams stellst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren landwirtschaftlichen Partnerbetrieben die Qualität und Transparenz unserer Ergebnisse sicher. Deine Aufgaben Du arbeitest als Werkstudent:in in unserem Verifizierungsteam. Deine Aufgabe besteht in der Prüfung von Betriebsdaten hinsichtlich der umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Betriebe. Du durchsichtest sorgfältig Betriebsdokumenten wie Agraranträge, Ackerschlagkartei, Düngebedarfsermittlungen, Saatgutbelege, Dienstleistungsrechnungen und Inventarlisten und überprüfst, dass die Datenlage auf unserer Plattform in Einklang mit der Dokumentation steht. Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung. Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen. Mit deiner Arbeit stellst du sicher, dass die von unserem Modell berechneten CO₂-Einspeicherungen und Einsparungen tatsächlich erreicht wurden. Dein Profil Du bist aktuell als Student:in an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Agrarwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst praktische Erfahrungen in der Landwirtschaft mit, z.B. durch persönlichen Hintergrund Du bringst großes Interesse an regenerativer Landwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Lösungen mit. Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und hast Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben – telefonisch und per E-Mail. Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du bist versiert im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Deine Benefits Growth : Einblicke in alle Arbeitsbereiche eines agilen Start-Ups und wertvolles Wissen über die moderne Arbeitswelt. Opportunity : Arbeite bei einem innovativen Unternehmen für regenerative Landwirtschaft und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Ziele erreichen. Impact : Dein Engagement trägt täglich zur Zukunftssicherheit der Landwirtschaft, zur Bodengesundheit und zum Klimaschutz bei. Autonomy : Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Flexibles Arbeitsmodell : Wir fördern flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten und ermöglichen es dir, aus unserem Berliner Büro oder remote zu arbeiten. Weitere Benefits für Mitarbeiter:innen in Deutschland: Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket, Team-Lunches (in Berlin) sowie regelmäßige Team-Events. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Bei Klim sind wir überzeugt, dass ein lebendiger und erfolgreicher Arbeitsplatz auf den vielfältigen Hintergründen, Talenten und Perspektiven unseres Teams basiert. Gemeinsam werden wir stärker, indem wir die individuellen Stärken jeder einzelnen Person wertschätzen und weiterentwickeln. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle geschätzt fühlen und die Möglichkeit haben, ihr volles Potenzial einzubringen. Alle Einstellungs- und Personalentscheidungen treffen wir ausschließlich auf Grundlage von Qualifikationen, Leistung und den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens – und gewährleisten so Fairness und Chancengleichheit für alle. Wenn dich diese Position begeistert, du aber nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich dennoch, dich zu bewerben. Vielleicht passt du auf eine Weise perfekt zu unserem Team, die du dir noch gar nicht vorstellen kannst! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce)
description: Deine Mission Alle reden über AI. Wir entscheiden, wie sie im Unternehmen wirklich eingesetzt wird. Ein 400-Milliarden-Dollar-Markt. Ein profitables Scale-up, das ihn mit AI und einem globalen Freelancer-Netzwerk neu denkt. Und mittendrin ein Team, das nicht primär Code schreibt, sondern entscheidet, was AI im Unternehmen bewirken soll - für mehr als 25.000 Talents in über 70 Ländern, durch Automatisierung und intelligente Prozesse. Wir suchen dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) Strategy & Business Development (AI-Taskforce) in unserem Headquarter in München -Schwabing für unsere cross-funktionale strategische Taskforce. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Strategy, Business und AI - als Sparringspartner:in für AI Engineers, Product- und Operations-Expert:innen sowie eine ehemalige BCG-Beraterin. Nicht als zusätzliche:r Engineer im Team, sondern als die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das Team das Richtige baut. Das ist keine klassische Werkstudentenstelle für Techies. Du strukturierst Probleme, baust Business Cases, bewertest AI-Anwendungen aus Business-Perspektive und übersetzt zwischen dem, was technisch möglich ist, und dem, was strategisch sinnvoll ist. Die Konzepte, an denen du arbeitest, landen nicht in einer Schublade - sie fließen direkt in Entscheidungen unseres Leadership-Teams ein. Was du wirklich machst AI-Strategie statt AI-Code: Du arbeitest an strategischen AI-Initiativen wie unserem Talent Assistant oder AutoQA 2.0 (KI-basierte Voice-File-Analyse) mit - nicht als Entwickler:in, sondern als jemand, der Anforderungen strukturiert, Prioritäten setzt und aus ersten Ideen belastbare Feature-Konzepte macht. Die technische Umsetzung übernehmen unsere AI Engineers; du sorgst dafür, dass sie das Richtige bauen. Aus Ideen werden Entscheidungen: Du analysierst komplexe Fragestellungen, baust Business Cases nach klassischer Case-Logik auf und entwickelst Entscheidungsgrundlagen für unser Leadership-Team. title: Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Deine Mission Skalierung braucht ein Fundament, das mitwächst. Über unsere Plattform laufen täglich Interaktionen von mehr als 25.000 Talents in 70+ Ländern, und mit unserem Wachstumsziel von 500 Mio. € Umsatz bis 2030 steigt der Anspruch an unsere Cloud-Platform, Deployment-Prozesse und Kosteneffizienz kontinuierlich. Als Platform & DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) im hybriden Modell an einem unserer Standorte in München, Berlin oder Halle (Saale) verantwortest du unsere Cloud Platform, primär auf Microsoft Azure. Du entscheidest, wie wir Infrastruktur designen, betreiben und optimieren, mit klarem Fokus auf Skalierbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du unsere CI/CD-Plattform und Self-Service-Tools weiter, die unseren Engineering-Teams schnelleres und sichereres Deployment ermöglichen. Deine Aufgaben Cloud Platform & Developer Enablement Azure Platform Ownership: Du verantwortest Design, Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Infrastruktur, von Compute und Networking bis Identity und Governance. Infrastructure as Code statt Klick-Administration: Du entwickelst und pflegst IaC mit Terraform, stellst wiederverwendbare Module bereit und automatisierst, was manuell fehleranfällig wäre. CI/CD-Plattform kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln: Du automatisierst Deployments über den gesamten Software-Lifecycle und baust Self-Service-Plattformen, die Dev-Teams eigenständiger machen. Developer Experience mitdenken: Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering und Product zusammen, um Delivery-Prozesse und Plattform-Fähigkeiten laufend zu verbessern. Platform Reliability, Security & Cost Efficiency Platform Reliability im Blick: Du monitorst Performance, Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität und gehst Infrastruktur- und Deployment-Probleme proaktiv an, bevor sie zum Incident werden. Security by Design: Gemeinsam mit unserem CISO-Team integrierst du Security Controls direkt in Plattform und CI/CD-Prozesse, inklusive Azure Security Services, Policies und Benchmarks. Kosteneffizienz als Designprinzip: Du optimierst Infrastruktur und Deployment-Plattformen konsequent auf Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Kosten, von Anfang an statt nachträglich. FinOps in der Praxis: Du baust Cloud-Cost-Monitoring, Budgeting und Forecasting auf und lieferst konkrete Empfehlungen zur laufenden Kostenoptimierung. Dein Skillset Cloud Platform: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure in Compute, Networking, Storage, Identity und Governance, plus Verständnis von Cloud-Architektur-Prinzipien auch über Azure hinaus. Automation: Routiniert mit Terraform, Bicep oder ARM, CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD oder vergleichbaren Tools produktiv aufgebaut, Configuration Management automatisiert statt manuell gepflegt. Container & Scripting: Erfahrung mit Docker und Kubernetes/Nomad oder Azure ACA/ACI, sichere Scripting-Skills in Python, PowerShell oder Bash. Observability & Security: Monitoring, Logging und Alerting im Alltag, angewandtes Verständnis von IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust und Privileged Identity Management, praktische Erfahrung mit GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 oder PCI DSS. FinOps: Cloud-Usage-Analyse, Ressourcenoptimierung und kosteneffiziente Architekturen als Teil deines Designs, nicht als Nachgedanke. Azure-Zertifizierungen, FinOps-Frameworks, Serverless-Architekturen oder Erfahrung mit verteilten oder hybriden Systemen sind ein Plus. Arbeitsweise: Analytisches, lösungsorientiertes Denken, Eigenverantwortung im interdisziplinären Umfeld, klare Kommunikation mit technischen wie nichttechnischen Stakeholdern, fließendes Englisch und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Dein Winning Deal Die Werte: Wir punkten mit einer offenen, authentischen Kultur und einem leistungsstarken sowie humorvollen Team, das sich schon jetzt darauf freut, mit dir mutige Entscheidungen zu treffen und neue Wege zu gehen, die uns zu nachhaltigen Erfolgen führen. Dein Footprint: Eine Position in einer profitablen Company, in der deine Infrastruktur-Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss auf Skalierung und Kosten haben, nicht nur auf dem Papier. Deine Chance: Bei uns hast du vom ersten Tag an die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Innovationen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit einem Team aus Expert:innen das Unternehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Benefits: Neben 30 Tagen Urlaub bieten wir dir außerdem einen "Joblunch"-Zuschuss (69 € im Monat), eine "Givve"-Card (wird monatlich mit 50 € aufgeladen) oder alternativ eine bezuschusste "Wellpass" Mitgliedschaft, Rabatte via "Corporate Benefits", die Möglichkeit eines "JobRad"-Leasings, Zuschüsse zur Altersvorsorge (bAV & VL) sowie grandiose Team- und Companyevents. Dein Arbeitsplatz: Bei uns arbeitest du im flexiblen, hybriden Modell aus einem unserer hundefreundlichen und modernen Offices und hast zudem die Möglichkeit auf 2 Wochen im Jahr Workation innerhalb der EU (*gilt nur für Mitarbeiter:innen mit EU-Pass). description: <h2><strong>About Black Forest Labs</strong></h2> <p>We’re the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We’re creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we’re just getting started.</p> <p>Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we’re scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.</p> <h2><strong>Why This Role</strong></h2> <p>Our models are already seeing strong inbound demand, and we’re expanding our commercial team to accelerate adoption across enterprise and strategic partners.</p> <p>We’re looking for someone who can translate deep technical interest into durable, long-term partnerships&nbsp; especially across complex, non-standard engagements involving APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing.</p> <p>This role owns the end-to-end commercial journey, working closely with research, engineering, and leadership to help customers move confidently from evaluation to production.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Work On</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from discovery through close and expansion across startups, scaleups, and enterprises</li> <li>Run complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving technical buyers, executives, and legal teams</li> <li>Design and execute sales motions across APIs, on-prem deployments, and custom licensing</li> <li>Build durable customer relationships that drive retention and long-term expansion</li> <li>Partner closely with solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineers, product, research, and legal on bespoke deals</li> <li>Translate customer needs and market signals into actionable feedback for product and research</li> <li>Help define early commercial processes, playbooks, and qualification frameworks as we scale</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <p>You’ve closed real, technically complex B2B deals and know how to operate without a playbook.</p> <p>You bring strong judgment navigating long sales cycles, highly competitive environments with ambiguous requirements, and evolving products, and you’re comfortable working cross-functionally to get deals done the right way, not just quickly.</p> <p><strong>You'll likely have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience selling technical products to tech executives, ML teams, and enterprise stakeholders</li> <li>Ability to discuss model capabilities, inference requirements, and integration tradeoffs with technical buyers</li> <li>Proven success managing long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing strategic landmark deals</li> <li>Strong negotiation skills across pricing, licensing, and custom commercial terms</li> <li>Track record building and scaling pipelines across different deal sizes and customer types</li> <li>Comfort shaping process and structure in fast-moving, early-stage environments</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How We Work Together</strong></h2> <p>We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. Depending on your role, you’ll either join us in Freiburg or SF at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week), or work remotely with a monthly in-person week to stay connected. We’ll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we’ve structured things to make it accessible to all. We’ll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.</p> <p><strong>Everything we do is grounded in four values:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Obsessed.</strong> We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.</li> <li><strong>Low Ego.</strong> The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. title: Data Scientist
description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. Neko Health is a Swedish healthcare technology company co-founded in 2018 by Hjalmar Nilsonne and Daniel Ek. Neko's vision is to shift healthcare from reactive treatment toward preventative health and early detection. This requires completely reimagining the patient's experience and incorporating the latest advances in sensors and AI. Neko Health has developed a new medical scanning technology concept to make it possible to do broad and non-invasive health data collection that is convenient and affordable for the public. The company is based in Stockholm, offering the Neko Body Scan experience at locations in Stockholm, London and Manchester, with over 500 employees. About the Role A Data Scientist at Neko Health develops and implements data solutions that drive insights from sensor and healthcare data, enabling clinical decision support, and supporting innovations. This role partners with clinical researchers, engineers, and other teams to enhance products through data-driven insights. Responsibilities Data Modeling and Analysis: Develop algorithms, statistical models and machine learning models to address targeted challenges using sensor and healthcare data. Develop performance evaluation and implement performance monitoring of data products to ensure that the intended value is delivered. Data Management: Prepare, clean, and integrate datasets from various sources, ensuring data quality and accuracy. Collaborate with Data Engineers to build and maintain scalable data pipelines for efficient analysis. Support for Clinical Studies: Collaborate with clinical teams to define targeted clinical hypotheses, study variables and collection methods for clinical studies. Perform exploratory analyses and provide data insights to refine study designs. Research and Innovation: Stay up-to-date on data science advances to continuously improve model accuracy, efficiency, and clinical relevance. Develop proofs-of-concept of new medical devices and methods. Support patent development. Maintenance, scaling, and common tooling: Improve robustness of products, streamlining of processes and increasing efficiency of data science development by applying good software engineering practices. Requirements: MSc or PhD degree in a quantitative field for example Computer Science, Machine Learning or Physics. Expertise within data science, algorithm development, and statistics. Strong analytical abilities, collaborative mindset, and solid software engineering skills. A strong proficiency in designing and implementing machine learning algorithms. About the Engineering Team Distributed and Remote First We are nearly 100 full time engineers at the company, working from Berlin, Chamonix, Hamburg, Lisbon, Marseille, Vilnius, and Stockholm, spanning diverse disciplines such as Hardware Engineering, Firmware Development, Electrical Design, Algorithm Development, Machine Learning Development, Optronics Research, Frontend Development and more. We don't expect people to join us with a specific tech knowledge, but we do expect you to work with our tools. We use a mix of React, Typescript, C++, and Python. Our APIs are written in C# with ASP.NET Core, uses Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure Active Directory for authentication. Our headquarters and our hardware development team are in Stockholm, Sweden. We are a Remote First company; however, it is of course much easier to work remotely as a software engineer than a hardware or firmware engineer (since they require access to hardware or devices occasionally). Software engineers based in Stockholm work maybe one day a week or one day every two weeks from the office. We meet a couple of times per year to get to know each other and have fun. Organization and Way of Working The engineering team is divided into smaller cross functional project teams that each focus on a specific goal or target, where some groups are long-lived, and some are short-lived, depending on how big the goal or deliverable is. We strive to create groups which are cross-functional and able to complete their goals without dependence on other teams, even though this is of course not always possible. Groups track goals on a yearly and quarterly basis with goal follow-up across the entire engineering organization on a bi-weekly basis. Most groups do internal planning on a bi-weekly basis, but in the end it's up to the group to decide how they want to work. We have, however, mandated that all groups must present their progress or failures or hacks at our bi-weekly engineering demo, a fun meeting/presentation where we talk about everything from short-circuiting power-modules, how hard it is to calibrate cameras or align polygons in space, to neat new command line tools for operations, a new auth mechanism in the backend, a cool new way to visualize health data or a new feature which helps our doctors be more productive. We have a flexible workplace that focuses on work/life balance, and we strongly believe in our mission but do not think that achieving it requires sacrificing everything else. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Junior Automation Specialist

About the Role

Customer Care at Perk is being rebuilt around automation and AI. This role is for someone who likes taking a messy operational problem and turning it into something that runs in production.

As an Automation Specialist, you'll design and ship the systems that cut manual work, make agents faster, and improve what customers actually experience. You'll work across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and whatever else the problem needs. Some days that's a workflow. Some days it's an AI tool with evals, guardrails, and a kill switch. The through-line is the same: get it from idea to live, then keep it reliable.

You'll partner with Operational Excellence, Customer Care Leadership, and Operations. You'll own delivery end to end, and you'll be measured on whether the things you build actually stick.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, test, and deploy solutions across Make.com, Airtable, Zendesk, Claude, APIs, and AI tooling.

  • Wire up multi-system integrations that remove real manual effort, not just move it around.

  • Own projects from the first sketch through production and ongoing improvement.

  • Stand up proper testing and validation environments so "it worked in my scenario" isn't the bar.

  • Turn business problems into technical designs, and flag new automation opportunities as you go.

  • Stay close after launch: watch adoption, fix what breaks, iterate on what underperforms

Build

  • Write automations that are maintainable, documented, and safe for someone else to pick up.

  • Monitor production systems, debug fast, and keep operational impact low when things go wrong.

  • Know when Make/Zapier-class tools are enough, and when the problem needs a different approach.

  • Keep an eye on new automation and AI capabilities, and bring the useful ones in deliberately.

Raise the bar

  • Be the person others ask when they're stuck on architecture, platform limits, or how to ship AI safely.

  • Review builds before they go live when that review actually reduces risk..

  • Create reusable components, patterns, and standards so the next build is faster and cleaner.

Teamwork

  • Sit with Opex and Operations until you understand the real problem, then design the right fix.

  • Shape discovery and scoping so solutions stay practical and maintainable.

  • Keep stakeholders clear on progress, risks, dependencies, and dates.

  • Feed operational feedback back into the next version.

What We're Looking For

  • Shipped production automations on Make.com, Zapier, Claude, or similar not just demos.

  • Worked with Airtable or comparable systems as a real ops backbone, not a side spreadsheet.

  • Built LLM-powered workflows with prompt craft, evaluation, and guardrails — and knows when the model shouldn't act alone.

  • Strong at debugging production systems under time pressure.

  • Can turn a fuzzy business request into something scalable and supportable.

  • Comfortable working with both technical and operational partners.

  • Prefers speed and ambiguity over perfect specs.

How We'll Know You're Winning

  • Automations that meaningfully cut manual work in Customer Care.

  • Multi-system builds that stay reliable once they're live.

  • High reliability, performance, and adoption — not just "launched".

  • Clear gains in operational efficiency, agent experience, and customer experience.

What we offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

Interview Process

Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual
Hiring Manager interview - 30-45mins Virtual
Assessment Interview - 30-60mins - In-person interview

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. raw.title: Technical Web Specialist (12-month fixed term contract)
raw.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Technical Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you’ll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work — the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do — so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don’t expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We’ll ask about how you use AI in your interviews — not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.
