About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more.

We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Foundations team, the backend backbone that builds the reliable, scalable, fast systems everyone else at Encord builds on top of. The team's core challenges sit deep in distributed and data-intensive systems.

The product mindset on this team is different from most of the company: short-term product insight matters less, long-term matters a lot. Foundations plans around how the next 6, 12, and 24 months will look, with an overarching shape to the problem: handling multiple orders of magnitude the data we handle today.

Encord is growing rapidly, with our product as the key driver of that growth. A year ago, we were a team of 100; now, we're over 150 and continuing to accelerate. The systems that got us here won't get us to what's next. That's the problem you'll help solve.

What you'll do

  • Take end-to-end ownership of significant projects within our database and processing systems, from design and architectural decisions all the way to deployment, monitoring, and measuring impact

  • Build robust distributed systems and reason carefully about how they fail and how they behave under load

  • Contribute to performant protocols and APIs, such as our label-format API, that customers use directly

  • Tackle complex domains and immense scale with simple solutions

  • Raise the bar through code reviews, pairing, and helping engineers around you do their best work

Who we're looking for

  • You've seen and built a lot. You have personally developed and maintained multiple systems from scratch, and you know what trade-offs are involved in building reliable, performant software at speed

  • You want your work to have a tangible outcome for people. You're not satisfied with building products that do not see the light of day

  • You are a builder. You enjoy all aspects of building not only software but a complete product, and are comfortable moving across the stack when necessary

  • You enjoy problem-solving and thinking from first principles, reach for the simplest solution that works, and know when boring technology wins

  • You're happy to tackle problems without a predefined, clear definition or obvious solution, and are excited to have autonomy to make decisions as you go

  • You understand that being a member of a high-performing team requires two things. You contribute your best work and help others contribute their best. You'll always lend a helping hand when needed and level up those around you

Experience requirements

  • 5+ years building large-scale backend infrastructure applications

  • Deep fluency in at least one high-level language (we use Python and TypeScript, but we care more about depth than the specific language)

  • Solid grounding in distributed systems concepts (databases, replication, partitioning, queuing, caching) and how they behave under load

  • Experience owning services in production and improving quality through code reviews, testing, rollout, and monitoring

  • Experience with data migrations or re-architecture projects is a plus

Tech stack

We are technology-agnostic at Encord and are not looking for experience across all of these. As long as you're open to learning, please apply.

  • Backend: Python

  • Frontend: TypeScript and React

  • Deployment: Kubernetes

  • Infrastructure: GCP

  • Machine learning: PyTorch, CUDA, Ray

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and meaningful equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture: the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

We're looking for a Mid level PHP Engineer to join our growing UK Loans team, either based in or around London

Our engineering organisation is home to over 200 talented engineers across backend, frontend, mobile, and platform disciplines.

You'll have the opportunity to work on everything from building and integrating new APIs to enhance the customer journey, to optimising our lending platforms, and engaging in deep architectural discussions. There's plenty to tackle, and we're excited to find the right people to take on the challenge.

 

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • 3+ years experience with PHP

  • Strong, business oriented, engineer with modern PHP development experience (PHP 8.0+ is a must)

  • High degree of ownership and autonomy

  • A good understanding of Symfony

  • Experience with Domain Driven Design, Message-Driven Systems and Event Sourcing would be a plus

  • Strong automatic testing skills (unit, integration, functional, behat)

Desirable

  • Experience working on financial systems

  • A keen desire to want to learn and input into a highly collaborative team

     

Our Tech Stack

We believe in using the right tools for the job, and our stack reflects our commitment to modern, efficient development:

  • Backend: PHP 8, Symfony 7, AWS, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD (we deploy to production as soon as a feature is complete!)

  • Testing: Behat, PHPUnit

     

Interview process

We value your time and have designed an efficient process to get to know you:

  1. A quick chat with one of our team to see if the role is a good match.

  2. A technical interview to assess your technical skills.

  3. A culture-add interview to assess how you'd thrive within our team and organisation.

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role:

As a Fraud & Disputes Specialist, you'll be at the forefront of protecting our credit card customers and business from financial crime, playing a vital role in our Fraud and Financial Crime Team. You'll have end-to-end ownership of complex investigations, making a direct impact on customer experience, and the effectiveness of our UK & US card products.

Key Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Case Ownership: Investigate and resolve complex third-party credit card fraud, consumer card disputes (including Section 75 claims), and chargebacks, ensuring meticulous accuracy and compliance with Mastercard guidelines.

  • Customer-Centric Resolution: Communicate empathetically and clearly with customers throughout the process, managing challenging scenarios like account takeovers and scams with professionalism and sound judgment.

  • Operational Excellence & Digital Adoption: Execute structured processes using our digital systems, proactively identifying trends and suggesting improvements to controls, workflows, and automation opportunities. You'll be a champion for new technologies, helping us work smarter and faster.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay ahead of emerging fraud typologies, regulatory changes, and new operational tools, sharing your expertise and contributing to a collaborative, improvement-focused team environment.

Your Experience & Skills:

  • Essential: Prior experience working with credit or debit card fraud, disputes, or chargebacks.

  • Advantageous: Good working knowledge of scheme rules (especially Mastercard) and relevant regulatory standards in the UK and/or USA.

  • Ability to confidently navigate and resolve complex customer scenarios with empathy and professionalism.

  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, thriving in a fast-paced and change-driven environment.

  • Digitally savvy and eager to embrace automation and new technologies.

  • Detail-oriented and process-driven, with a knack for spotting inefficiencies and suggesting practical improvements.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Your Profile & Approach:

  • Customer-Focused: Deeply committed to customer protection and delivering positive outcomes.

  • Accountable: Takes personal ownership for every case and champions process enhancements.

  • Proactive & Solutions-Oriented: Open to new approaches, including automation and digital transformation.

  • Constructive & Collaborative: Eager to identify better ways of working and contribute to a supportive team culture.

  • Maintains the highest standards of confidentiality, integrity, and compliance.

Interview Process:

1) A 15 minute Cognitive Assessment

2) A 30 minute call with a member of the Talent team

3) An onsite Interview and assessment with the Fraud & Disputes Manager

4) Interview with the Head of Fraud and Financial Crime

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

description: Job Description At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too. We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time. Key responsibilities: Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand. Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools. Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration). Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself. Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating. Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling. Your background: A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work. Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration. Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast. A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet. A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop. You’ll Thrive Here If You… You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human). You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners). You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners). You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple). KPIs & Success Measures Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings. Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet. Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support. Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews. Benefits: 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme Health insurance / private medical cover Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development Remote - work from anywhere in your home country Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees Flexible working hours Deep Dive About Pencil Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI. We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past. Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500. https://www.trypencil.com About The Brandtech Group The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology. It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022. Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever. In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. raw.description:
Job Description

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Generative AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn’t just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

We're looking for a Security & Trust Specialist to join Pencil at a pivotal moment of growth. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone with a background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role who is now building a career in security. You'll own the day-to-day security operations that keep Pencil safe — endpoints, identity and access, cloud and SaaS security — and you're happy to lend a hand with practical IT and device issues where needed. You'll work directly with our Head of Security & Trust, who will support your growth into the audit, compliance and vendor-risk side of the role over time.

Key responsibilities:

  • Administer and secure endpoints (MDM/Intune, patching, encryption, device compliance), and be willing to pitch in on practical desktop support and device issues when the team needs a hand.

  • Own day-to-day identity and access management — joiner/mover/leaver processes, least-privilege access and quarterly access reviews across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, GCP and other SaaS tools.

  • Monitor security alerts and logs, escalate promptly, and help investigate and document security events (suspicious logins, compromised credentials, device loss, cloud misconfiguration).

  • Support compliance evidence collection in Vanta for SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001, working alongside the Head of Security & Trust rather than owning audit strategy yourself.

  • Help gather evidence for vendor and customer security questionnaires, and flag anything that needs escalating.

  • Identify and implement practical improvements to monitoring, alerting and access control across cloud and endpoint tooling.

Your background:

  • A background in desktop support, IT systems administration or a similar technical operations role, now moving into (or already doing blended IT/security) work.

  • Hands-on experience with endpoint management (Intune or similar MDM) and Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 administration.

  • Comfortable with cloud basics (GCP, AWS or Azure IAM) — you don't need deep cloud engineering experience, but you're curious and capable of learning fast.

  • Some exposure to compliance or audit evidence gathering (Vanta or similar) is a bonus, not required.

  • A security certification such as CompTIA Security+, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity or Microsoft SC-900 — or clear evidence of self-directed learning if you don't have one yet.

  • A genuinely helpful, practical approach — you don't mind switching between security work and helping a colleague with their laptop.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

  • You enjoy being hands-on and don't mind switching between strategic security work and practical, in-the-moment IT problems (Human).

  • You're hungry to grow a career in security and want to learn from the audits and questionnaires you'll be exposed to (Owners).

  • You take ownership of problems end-to-end and don't wait to be told what to do (Owners).

  • You can explain technical issues simply to non-technical colleagues (Simple).

 

KPIs & Success Measures

  • Access reviews and joiner/mover/leaver tasks completed within SLA, with zero access-control audit findings.

  • Endpoint compliance rate (encryption, patching, MDM enrolment) across the device fleet.

  • Time-to-close on security incidents and IT/device issues you support.

  • Quality and completeness of evidence you contribute to Vanta and vendor reviews.

 

Benefits:

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We’re called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group’s mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco Itaú, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of Pokémon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content,, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

https://www.thebrandtechgroup.com

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>2900 – Data Engineer - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p><strong>About WPP Media Global Client Solutions</strong></p> <p>WPP Media's Global client teams are organised within a centralised squad based in London.&nbsp; A critical part of that is the WPP Media Global 'Strategy and Capabilities' team - a unit of 160 specialists focused on industry leading Strategic Planning, Insights and Innovation, working across WPP's global clients including Nestlé, Coca Cola, Danone, Unilever, AirBnB, Ford, Adidas, IKEA, L'Oreal and more. We operate at the forefront of the industry, collaborating seamlessly across WPP's ecosystem of experts to deliver integrated strategies and drive tangible business outcomes. We believe in the power of media to transform businesses and connect deeply with consumers.</p> <p>WPP Media is looking for a Data Engineer with interest in machine learning (ML) engineering, as well as the productionisation and optimization of ML models to join our Global Data Strategy &amp; Insights team.&nbsp; While operating within our team you will be asked to use our proprietary and/or client data along with ML techniques to help answer client questions around audiences like: ‘which audience should I be advertising to?’, ‘how should my strategy be different when approaching this audience?’, ‘how is does my media plan need to change across geographies?’. You will also be assisting our team in developing products to help both our global and local teams with day-to-day media planning. This reaches from hypothesis testing, data experiments, and predictive and prescriptive analysis.</p> <p>In this role, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with other data scientists and engineers (e.g. in our Analytics team) with experience and expertise in a wide range of methodologies, toolkits and applications to a variety of problems in the media landscape. This reaches from data engineering, setting and defining best practices and scaling ML POCs. You will also be collaborating with strategists, insights specialists and non-technical stakeholders to ensure the data structures align with the client use case and specifications.&nbsp;</p> <p>The ideal candidate would be curious, flexible and passionate about using data science/ML as a tool to understand human behaviour, campaign effectiveness and business dynamics. We are a data agnostic team that believe the key to success is not just having access to different types of data (market research, surveys, online behavioural panels, site data, targeted web-scraping) but finding new, innovative ways to connect and analyse the data we have access to, to deliver real, actionable, insight for our clients.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities for this position include:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Using data engineering techniques to clean, process and re-format large volumes of data</li> <li>Implementing coding changes to our existing tools to improve them or adapt them for different use cases</li> <li>Testing functionalities of our various tools and providing feedback on improvements that can be implemented.</li> <li>Assisting our Fusion Data Scientist in preparing different types of data for data fusion (incl. mapping variables, recoding data etc.)</li> <li>Performing checks on survey data and preparing data for trend analysis</li> <li>Develop and maintain a number of our Python packages</li> <li>Ingesting survey data into different tools to be used for insights, planning, modelling and reporting (both WPP Media and WPP Data Tech Solutions )</li> <li>Assisting in the development of new products/tools</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Curiosity, flexibility, problem solving skills, a scientific mindset and an enthusiasm for learning new things are key attributes.</li> <li>Fundamentally interested in people - Interested in the world around you and what makes people behave the way they do and how data and research can get you closer to understanding it.</li> <li>Able to work well as part of a team – you understand that one person can’t do or know everything and so you are willing to explore alternative routes, even if they are outside your comfort zone.</li> <li>Fast learner, with the ability to work across multiple workstreams at once</li> <li>Excited by telling stories from information by weaving different sources together into a convincing whole.</li> <li>Able to think critically and with curiosity about information sources</li> <li>Able to manage multiple stakeholders&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills we need:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong analytical skills and statistical knowledge, as well as interest in applying them to complex problems</li> <li>Competent with Python</li> <li>Comfortable manipulating and reshaping data to suit a particular task or tale</li> <li>Knowledge of Git</li> <li>Able to communicate ideas well, both verbally and written to both technical and non-technical stakeholders</li> <li>Knowledge of cloud computing (desirable)</li> <li>Knowledge of docker (desirable)</li> <li>Exposure to SQL, R, SPSS or other programming languages (desirable)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media &amp; Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to&nbsp;Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also&nbsp;Lead Optimistically,&nbsp;firmly believing&nbsp;in and&nbsp;Championing Growth and Development&nbsp;for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to&nbsp;leverage&nbsp;the extensive global WPP Media &amp; WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the&nbsp;cutting edge&nbsp;of marketing and advertising.&nbsp;</p> <p>We&nbsp;Create an Open environment&nbsp;built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events&nbsp;showcasing&nbsp;team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when&nbsp;we're&nbsp;together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment.&nbsp;That's&nbsp;why&nbsp;we’ve&nbsp;adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you&nbsp;require&nbsp;accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.&nbsp; Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <p>MongoDB Professional Services (PS) works with customers of all shapes and sizes, in all verticals, from tier-1 banks to small web startups, on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, networks with industry leaders, and sees new places – all in a day’s work!</p> <p>MongoDB PS exists to support the development of our customers’ vision, accelerate customers’ time to value, and drive a multitude of customer adoption scenarios – from building new solutions to modernizing legacy applications or migrating to cloud. Our consulting solutions ensure that organizations get the best out of MongoDB.</p> <p>This role will be based remotely in Great Britain</p> <h3>We’re looking for someone with:</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years of software development/consulting/support experience, preferably in a number of distinct industries/verticals</li> <li>Competence in at least one of the following languages (in no particular order): Java, C#, Python, Node.js (JavaScript), Ruby, Go</li> <li>Experience with databases such as MongoDB, Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL</li> <li>Familiarity with Linux diagnostics and tuning; Windows tuning knowledge is a plus</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations</li> <li>Excellent analytical, diagnostic skills, and problem-solving skills</li> <li>High motivation for a role that combines deep technical and customer-management dimensions</li> <li>Confidence speaking and presenting in a collaborative customer setting</li> <li>Should be capable and comfortable with frequent travel for short trips to customer sites during the working week (up to 15%)</li> <li>Experience working with Public Sector customers</li> </ul> <h3>What you will do in this role:</h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to customer implementations at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: portfolio assessment, application planning and design, deployment architectures, development and build, integration and release configuration, system testing, production operations, application optimization, and best practices adoption</li> <li>Deliver customer classroom-based training to architect, developer, and operations roles</li> <li>Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising fellow consulting engineers, project managers, and account teams</li> <li>Cultivate your individual MongoDB reputation as a trusted advisor to guide MongoDB and our customers into the future</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap</li> </ul> <h3>As a Senior Consulting Engineer, you will be successful in this role when you can execute the following:</h3> <ul> <li>Become a field expert in “everything MongoDB”</li> <li>Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences</li> <li>Gain a reputation as a trusted advisor with your clients, large and small</li> <li>Ensure your client’s success with their MongoDB endeavors</li> <li>Maintain the required level of billable utilization</li> <li>Influence MongoDB product development by contributing experience from the field</li> <li>Successfully communicate the product roadmap to external clients</li> <li>Constantly work on improving yourself, our products, and our team</li> </ul> <h3>About MongoDB</h3> <p>MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.</p> <p>With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.</p> <p>Our compass at MongoDB is our <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company">Leadership Commitment,</a> guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.&nbsp;</p> <p>To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. <a href="https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb">From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy</a>, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys.<a href="https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture"> Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB</a>, and help us make an impact on the world!</p> <p>MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. title: Product Designer - Core UX
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're looking for a <strong>Product Designer</strong> to help shape the shared experiences and systems that connect Hudl's products.</p> <p>Hudl is bringing together products used across sports, teams and organizations into a more connected platform. That creates design problems that don't always fit neatly within a single feature or product: how information is structured, how common workflows behave across products, how video and data work together, and how emerging technologies like AI change the way people interact with Hudl.</p> <p>You'll work within Core UX, the team responsible for the design foundations that help Hudl's products feel clear, consistent and connected. Our work includes shared patterns and experiences, information architecture, video and data, and the systems that help product teams build at scale.</p> <p>In this role, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Solve connected problems.</strong> You'll work on experiences that cross features, products and workflows, considering how individual design decisions fit into the broader Hudl platform.</li> <li><strong>Make complexity easier to understand.</strong> You'll turn complicated workflows, information and technical constraints into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.</li> <li><strong>Work across teams.</strong> You'll partner with product, engineering and other designers to understand problems, explore solutions and help create experiences that can work at scale.</li> <li><strong>Design from evidence.</strong> You'll learn directly from customers, use research and product data to inform your work, and test and iterate on ideas as you go.</li> <li><strong>Own your work through delivery.</strong> You'll independently run scoped design projects, working from early exploration through implementation and measuring how well the solution works once it's shipped.</li> </ul> <p><strong>For this role, we're currently considering candidates who are within commuting distance of our offices in London, but we're also open to remote candidates in the U.K.</strong></p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong product design craft.</strong> You can turn complex requirements into clear, intuitive experiences through strong interaction and visual design. MOD)</li> </ul> <hr> <h2>What Success Looks Like</h2> <h3>First 90 Days</h3> <ul> <li>Document MDI's architectural strategy: current state, target state, and gaps</li> <li>Establish RFC/review process title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the Role We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers. In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios. This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised What You’ll Be Doing As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will: Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance. Own your team’s core metrics. Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies. Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays. Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points. Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks. Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle: Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention. Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs. Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams. Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence. What You Bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments. Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs. A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value. Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools. Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent. A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting. Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus Nice to have: Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals. Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment You want to make a highly visible, regional impact This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer a steady, predictable corporate routine You want to step away from the frontline You view Customer Success as purely “customer happiness" How You’ll Develop in this Role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll: Establish a highly cohesive, high-performing UKI CS team structure for our CSMs. Deliver measurable improvements in UKI customer retention, renewal execution, and expansion pipelines. Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market. Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base. Location Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 mins interview with the hiring manager to deep dive into your experience and what you can bring to the team Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take-home test to showcase your onboarding strategy and data driven approach and invite you to a 60 mins team interview to present your challenge and to know part of the team Final Interview: Final conversation with a senior leader Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we hired a Manager, Customer Success, we received a vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background. Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Highlight the most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Customer Success to lead our UKI team within the Large and High Growth segment. Joining our Customer Experience department, you will be responsible for executing our regional CS strategy, driving team performance, and ensuring an exceptional experience for our most strategic UKI customers.

In this role, you will directly manage, coach, and scale a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Your mission is to operationalise our customer success motions, ensuring your team successfully drives product adoption, value realisation, retention, and expansion across their portfolios.

This role is ideal for an experienced B2B SaaS or Fintech people leader who thrives in fast-paced environments. You should bring a strong execution discipline, a commercial mindset, and a passion for frontline coaching to help your team turn complex customer challenges into simple, impactful solutions.

 

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director, Customer Success (large and high growth) and leading a dedicated regional team of CSMs. The team is highly collaborative and dedicated to retain the largest customers of Pleo. You’ll also have the chance to work closely with UKI commercial team, account managers, customer support, onboarding, product and RevOps to ensure customer risk is addressed early and growth opportunities are maximised

 

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Manager of Customer Success, you will:

  • Lead and coach a team of 10 CSMs, providing active coaching, career development, and daily operational guidance to ensure consistent, high-quality performance.

  • Own your team’s core metrics.

  • Implement and iterate on segment-specific success plans, engagement motions, renewal readiness playbooks, and risk-mitigation strategies.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure seamless customer transitions, aligned account strategies, and coordinated execution during renewals and expansion plays.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for UKI strategic accounts, working cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Operations to eliminate friction points.

  • Use operational insights, data dashboards, and forecasting metrics to track team productivity, evaluate portfolio health, and proactively address churn risks.

Immediate priorities you can expect to tackle:

  • Strengthening localised account health visibility and proactive risk intervention.

  • Building high-impact execution habits across your team of 10 CSMs.

  • Improving renewal readiness and commercial handoffs with the UKI Sales teams.

  • Fostering a culture of accountability, continuous feedback, and performance excellence.

 

What You Bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, with a proven track record of 2+ years directly managing high-performing teams in B2B SaaS, fintech, or fast-paced technology environments.

  • Strong experience supporting large, mid-market, or enterprise-level accounts with complex stakeholders and sophisticated commercial needs.

  • A strong commercial acumen - you seamlessly connect day-to-day customer health to retention, expansion, and long-term business value.

  • Deep familiarity with Customer Success methodologies, customer lifecycles, health scoring, and risk mitigation tools.

  • Excellent people leadership skills with a proven ability to hire, inspire, hold accountable, and develop talent.

  • A data-driven approach, comfortable utilising CRM and CS tooling (e.g.Hubspot, Vitally) to drive team performance and forecasting.

  • Fluency in English with exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. Other languages are a plus

Nice to have:

  • Direct experience in fintech, spend management, payments, or financial operations verticals.

  • Experience scaling team structures from smaller cohorts to larger regional pods.

 

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love combining frontline coaching with commercial strategy

  • You thrive in high-velocity, evolving environment

  • You want to make a highly visible, regional impact

This role is not a good fit for you if:

How You’ll Develop in this Role

  • Build a deep understanding of our product ecosystem to successfully advocate for the needs of our UKI market.

  • Be recognized as a vital execution partner to our Director of CS and a champion for our large and high-growth customer base.

 

Location

Job Summary

As a Senior Solution Consultant – ITSM, you will act as a trusted advisor to our customers, helping them translate business and service management challenges into practical, scalable solutions built on Atlassian tools and industry best practices.

You will lead discovery and solution design, guide customers through ITSM transformation, and own the solution intent throughout delivery. Working closely with Technical Consultants, Technical Architects, Project Managers, Engagement Managers, and Sales, you will ensure solutions remain feasible, aligned with customer needs, and focused on measurable outcomes.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

Discover & Advise

  • Lead discovery and scoping workshops to understand customer objectives, pain points, processes, constraints, maturity, and desired outcomes
  • Analyze and challenge existing service management processes and recommend practical improvements based on ITSM and Atlassian leading practices
  • Translate customer requirements into solution themes, priorities, success measures, and implementation considerations
  • Advise customers across ITSM practices such as incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management, service portals, and service operations
  • Facilitate conversations with business and technical stakeholders and identify where additional specialist expertise is required

    • Design & Shape Solutions

    • Translate business needs into high-level solution designs, roadmaps, configuration blueprints, and implementation-ready recommendations
    • Design scalable ITSM solutions leveraging Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian ecosystem
    • Produce clear deliverables including discovery outputs, current-state and future-state process maps, Solution Design Documents, requirements, acceptance criteria, decision logs, and requirements traceability
    • Document assumptions, dependencies, design decisions, trade-offs, and unresolved questions to maintain a shared understanding of the solution
    • Collaborate with Technical Consultants and Technical Architects to validate feasibility, scalability, integrations, automation, reporting, and platform constraints

      • Own & Guide Delivery

      • Own the solution intent throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring requirements, design decisions, acceptance criteria, and business outcomes remain visible during delivery
      • Support delivery teams by clarifying business context, requirements, design rationale, and customer priorities when questions or trade-offs arise
      • Facilitate solution checkpoints, design reviews, and working sessions with business and technical stakeholders
      • Partner with Project Managers and Technical Leads to maintain alignment between the approved solution design and delivered outcomes
      • Help ensure solutions remain appropriate for the customer’s maturity, constraints, and stated success measures

        • Contribute to proposals and Statements of Work where solution design, assumptions, acceptance criteria, dependencies, or delivery risks need to be clarified
        • Identify gaps, risks, dependencies, and scope boundaries before opportunities transition into delivery
        • Build and maintain trusted customer relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle
        • Identify opportunities for optimization, expansion, or follow-on advisory work and collaborate with the appropriate Sales or Engagement owner

          • Contribute & Grow

          • Mentor Consultants on discovery, advisory practices, solution documentation, and customer-facing communication
          • Contribute to internal playbooks, discovery frameworks, reusable ITSM solution assets, process maps, and delivery templates
          • Share knowledge and leading practices across the Solution Consulting and wider Delivery teams
          • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, documentation, synthesis, quality review, and knowledge reuse while ensuring outputs remain accurate and customer-specific
          • Stay current with developments across the Atlassian ecosystem and trends in ITSM, ESM, Agile, Work Management, automation, reporting, and enterprise collaboration
          • Maintain and develop your expertise through continuous learning and relevant certifications
 

Do You Have What It Takes?

To succeed in this role, you bring:

  • Significant experience in ITSM consulting, solution consulting, or service management transformation
  • Strong knowledge of Jira Service Management and the Atlassian ecosystem
  • Demonstrated experience leading customer discovery, requirements, and solution design workshops
  • Strong understanding of ITSM practices, including incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset and configuration management
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into practical solution designs and implementation recommendations
  • Experience producing high-quality customer-facing solution documentation, process maps, requirements, and acceptance criteria
  • Ability to balance customer expectations, business outcomes, platform capabilities, technical constraints, and delivery realities
  • Experience collaborating with technical consultants, architects, project managers, and commercial teams
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the development of less experienced consultants
  • Atlassian and/or ITIL certifications are a plus

    • Your strengths

    • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder management abilities
    • Ability to engage confidently with both business and technical stakeholders
    • Consultative mindset with the ability to challenge constructively and influence decisions
    • Ability to simplify complex requirements and turn them into clear, actionable solutions
    • Strong sense of ownership while working collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams
    • Proactive and pragmatic approach to solving customer challenges
    • Attention to detail and commitment to high-quality deliverables
    • Customer-focused approach with a strong orientation toward measurable outcomes
    • Ability to mentor and support the growth of other consultants

title: Director, Customer Support Network Strategy, Service Design & Workforce Management
description: <p>Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:</p> <ol> <li>Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?</li> <li>How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?</li> <li>How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?</li> </ol> <p>This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.</p> <h2><strong>Scope of Responsibility</strong></h2> <h3><strong>A. Support Service Design</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy.&nbsp;</li> <li>Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.</li> <li>Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.</li> <li>Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.</li> <li>Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.</li> <li>Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>B. Support Site Strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.</li> <li>Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.</li> <li>Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.</li> <li>Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.</li> <li>Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>C. Workforce Management Transformation</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.</li> <li>Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.</li> <li>Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.</li> <li>Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through:</li> <ul> <li>Org consolidation:&nbsp; merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.</li> <li>Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.</li> <li>AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.</li> <li>Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.</li> </ul> <li>Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>D. DoorDash Technology Integration</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.</li> <li>Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.</li> <li>Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.</li> <li>Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>E. Execution Planning</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.</li> <li>Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.</li> <li>Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Core Ongoing Responsibilities &amp;</strong> Outcomes</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Current state visibility:</strong> Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt &amp; Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.</li> <li><strong>DoorDash technology translation:</strong> Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.</li> <li><strong>Support site strategy:</strong> Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros &amp; cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.</li> <li><strong>Planning mechanisms:</strong> Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.</li> <li><strong>WFM transformation:</strong> Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.</li> <li><strong>Roadmap ownership:</strong> Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder alignment:</strong> Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.</li> </ul> <p>All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.</p> <h2><strong>Operating Rhythm</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Embed &amp; Orient (ongoing as scope evolves):</strong> Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo &amp; DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.</li> <li><strong>Diagnose:</strong> Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams;
